$note: Written after looking at every shot at 0%, 33%, 66% and 94% in out/.frames-<id>/, plus the rendered reel. Scores are one person's judgement out of ten and are deliberately NOT computed: every reel this repo has shipped broken passed the computed gates.
question: How Does the Human Heart Pump Blood?
verdict: The weakest of the five and the most useful. An anatomy explainer is the purest test of 'show, do not tell', and this one tells for fifty seconds: twenty-two shots, all typography, over a flat mustard field that never changes. The sentence the episode is built around -- the tenth of a second of delay between the upper chambers and the lower -- is exactly what motion design exists for, and it is delivered as two lines of text. It also produced the benchmark's only semantically WRONG picture before the script was reworded.
whatWorked: The script is sound and correctly ordered: two pumps, two circuits, why one wall is thicker, the valves, the spark, the delay, why the delay matters, the count, the lifetime figure.
Nothing false is shown in the final cut. The reel refuses rather than approximating.
The closing figure -- two and a half billion beats -- is the right ending for the script.

whatFailed.what: BEFORE THE FIX: a train of meshing gears was drawn as a schematic reconstruction of a human heart.
whatFailed.why: chooseRepresentation matched the word 'mechanism' plus the figure four and emitted a gearSystem. The hard semantic gate guards PHOTOGRAPHS only -- a procedural visual is never checked for whether it depicts the subject. The drawing then labelled itself SCHEMATIC RECONSTRUCTION, which is the repo's own definition of a worse lie than a wrong photograph. Fixed at the episode level by rewording the line; the hole in the engine is still open.

whatFailed.what: The delay between atrial and ventricular contraction is never animated.
whatFailed.why: No representation for a two-stage cycle. This is the episode's central claim.
gold-heat over the wash field produces one flat tone that fills the frame; with no plate to light, every shot is the same colour. A writer's mood choice compounding the supply problem.

whatFailed.what: Lowest motion density of the five, and one shot holds 3.2s on a single event.
whatFailed.why: With no diagram and no props surviving the type band, the only event available is the caption.
